description: KNOWN GAP: kintex7 LVDS input (RIOB18 diff-in segbits missing in prjxray db)
why: Routes fine; fasm2frames rejects RIOB18.IOB_Y0.IBUFDS_BANK_GLUE / SSTL*.IN_DIFF / *.IN_ONLY — the kintex7 HP-bank differential-input bits were never fuzzed upstream. Genesys2/KC705 only have LVDS clocks, so kintex7 shipped no boards and left the manifest (round 3). While kintex7 is out, this fails earlier (no chipdb bin); when it returns it fails at fasm2frames; when the db gap is fixed it PASSES and this guard trips: flip it to a positive test and re-enable the boards.
